Introduction

Choi Minho is a South Korean singer, rapper, and actor under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group SHINee. He officially debuted with SHINee on May 22, 2008 with the group's first mini album "Replay". Minho later made his solo debut with the single, "I'm Home", on March 28, 2019.
